titel: LANcelot · Quizzes, polls and class games on your own classroom network
omschrijving: Classroom app for teachers: live quizzes, polls, {n} games, AI worksheets and tests. Runs on the PC in your classroom, students join in their browser.

hero.kicker: Made by a teacher, for the classroom
hero.titel: Everything for your class, on your own network
hero.wereld: A world of knights from the future: castles and dragons, with neon, lasers and robots. Every lesson becomes a quest through the realm of LANcelot.
hero.tekst: LANcelot runs on the PC in your classroom. Students scan the QR code on the board and play along on their Chromebook, tablet or phone. No student accounts, no limit on students or questions.
hero.noot: Coming soon · Windows PC · Students join in the browser

punten.tekst: Quizzes, polls, games, worksheets, tests and classroom tools in one app.
Play runs over the school network. Fast, even with 30 devices at once.
Names and results stay on the PC in your classroom.

lijst.tekst: Double-click on the classroom PC. The teacher screen opens on the board.
They scan the QR code or type the address. Enter a name and done.
You pick the quiz and the game. The class plays along, you follow everything live.

schermen.bord: The board: everything starts from five halls

hallen.titel: Five halls, one way of working
hallen.tekst: Every part has an icon and one sentence of explanation. Know one hall and you know them all.

lijst.tekst: Practise through play with your own quizzes: quick quizzes, duels, team games and adventures.
Ask the whole class: polls, statements, word clouds, open questions and circle time.
Make quizzes, worksheets and tests, with AI or by hand. Play them live or print them with an answer key.
Classroom tools on the board: picker, groups, timer, noise meter, dice and class jobs.
Your class list, your country's curriculum goals or your own, tasks per pupil and the results.

spellen.tekst: Every game plays with every quiz. Right answers give fuel, ammo, energy or a power. Answer well and you get further.

spel.quizTekst: With any quiz from the Forge: your own or made with AI.
spel.toestellenTekst: Chromebook, laptop, tablet or phone, in the browser

ai.titel: Lesson material in seconds, with AI
ai.tekst: Give a topic and the grade, or drop in a photo of your textbook. The AI makes a quiz, a worksheet or a full set per lesson, on three levels.
lijst: Works with Gemini, ChatGPT or Claude: LANcelot copies the prompt, you paste the answer back.
Or enter your own key and everything happens in one click.
Play worksheets live in class or print them with an answer key.
Only creating with AI needs the internet. Play runs over the classroom network.

niveaus.titel: Every student at their own level
niveaus.tekst: Per subject you choose a level for each student. Quizzes, worksheets and tasks adapt.

lijst.tekst: Extra support and easier questions
The regular content
A challenge for those who can go further

opvolgen.tekst: Every answer goes into the log, linked to the goals you choose. You see at once who needs extra help.

lijst.tekst: Students who need the most attention are at the top. See which goals the whole class should revisit, who needs small-group instruction and which mistakes keep coming back.
Assign a quiz or worksheet to one student or a small group, each at their own level. You can prepare it at home too.
Choose the curriculum goals of England, the US, the Netherlands, Germany, France or Flanders, or add your own. An AI can suggest them. Working without goals is fine too.
Make a test in the Forge, let pupils take it online or print it. The scores go straight into your overview.

motivatie.titel: Why students look forward to it every day

lijst.tekst: Helmet, armour, weapon and shield of their choice. The knight plays along in every game.
With Honour for effort and growth, every student builds their own castle. No leaderboard.
An egg that hatches and grows along. There is no punishment.
A secret word to crack every day, on three levels.

privacy.titel: Student data stays in your classroom
lijst: LANcelot runs on your own PC. No cloud and no student accounts.
Names, answers and results live in a folder on that PC. You decide what happens to them.
If you use AI, only your prompt (topic or lesson material) goes to the AI you choose. No student names.

toestellen.titel: Works on what your class already has

lijst.tekst: The teacher screen and the game
Simply in the browser
Scan the QR code and play

talen.tekst: Dutch, English, French, Spanish and German. Pick the language in the settings and every screen switches, students' screens too.

junior.tekst: For the youngest classes, ages 5 to 9. The same knights and dragons, with games made for small hands and children who cannot read (fluently) yet.

lijst.tekst: Every task is spoken out loud in your class's language. Even children who cannot read yet play on their own.
Counting and sums, measuring and time, shapes, letters and sounds, the world, music and getting along.

lijst.naam: On the board or on tablets
lijst.tekst: The whole class in four teams, two children sharing a tablet, or each child on their own tablet.
Children explore a wizard village together and look after their own class dragon.

beelden.spel: Counting dragon eggs on the board

junior.noot: LANcelot Junior comes in the same app. One button switches between LANcelot and LANcelot Junior.

lijst.v: Does LANcelot work with my country's goals?
lijst.a: Yes. In My class, choose your country's curriculum goals, add your own, or work without goals. Every answer then lands under the right goal in your overview.
Play runs over the school's local network: the PC and the students' devices must be on the same network. Only creating lesson material with AI needs the internet.
No. They type their name and play. LANcelot remembers their knight and results on the classroom PC.
There is no limit. A whole class of thirty plays smoothly, on Chromebooks, tablets and phones mixed.
A Windows PC (usually the one connected to the board), the school network and devices with a browser for the students.

lijst.v: Can I use my own lesson content?
lijst.a: Of course. Write quizzes yourself, let the AI make them from your own textbook or PDF, and sort everything into folders per subject and lesson.

voet.door: LANcelot is made by Jorn Duthoo, a primary school teacher in Belgium.
